errors.text_span: която визуализира броя на сигналите за забелязани неточности, свързани с различни допълнителни услуги
errors.evidence: The chart's title is "Други услуги" (Other services). The description incorrectly infers that the entire chart's purpose is to show the "number of signals for noticed inaccuracies", which is only one of the several categories presented.

errors.text_span: които са разположени в азбучен ред
errors.evidence: The categories are not arranged in alphabetical order in the chart. The description incorrectly states they are.

errors.text_span: „отчети“, „статистики“, „RSS alerts услуги“, „сигнали за забелязани неточности“ и „друго“
errors.evidence: The list of categories is incorrect. The chart shows six categories ("статистики", "отчети", "alerts услуги", "RSS", "сигнали за забелязани неточности", "друго"), but the description lists only five, incorrectly merging "alerts услуги" and "RSS" into a single non-existent category "RSS alerts услуги".

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос (ордината) представлява броя на сигналите
errors.evidence: The vertical axis is unlabeled and represents a generic count or quantity. The description incorrectly interprets it as specifically the "number of signals", based on one of the category labels.

errors.text_span: като са видими отметки на нивата 1, 2, 3, 5 и 7
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the data labels on top of the bars as axis tick marks. The vertical axis has regular gridlines at integer intervals, not just at the levels of 1, 2, 3, 5, and 7.

The description swaps the values for the categories "отчети" and "статистики". According to the chart, the bar for "статистики" (the first bar, blue) has a value of 7, and the bar for "отчети" (the second bar, red) has a value of 2.
The description hallucinates a category named "RSS alerts услуги" by merging two distinct categories shown in the figure: "RSS" and "alerts услуги".
